name: How quickly should I address smoke-damaged furniture?

mainEntity.name: How quickly should I address smoke-damaged furniture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Addressing smoke-damaged furniture promptly is critical to maximize restoration success. Smoke residues are acidic and can cause progressive damage, discoloration, and etching on surfaces over time. Odors also become more deeply embedded the longer they sit. Ideally, professional cleanup should begin within a few days of the incident to prevent permanent damage and ensure more effective odor removal. Delaying treatment can significantly reduce the chances of full restoration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Address smoke-damaged furniture quickly, ideally within days, to prevent permanent damage, discoloration, and deeply embedded odors.
